# Jabbit - Peptide Tracking App
> Jabbit is an iPhone app for people who take GLP-1 medications or other injectable peptides. It logs doses and injection sites, tracks vials and reconstitution, estimates medication levels, and records progress. No account; records stay on the user's iPhone (no iCloud sync since version 1.0.4). Made by Bridger Apps, LLC.

## Key Features
- Smart injection tracking with 14-zone site rotation
- Vial management with reconstitution calculator
- Real-time serum level visualization (pharmacokinetic curves)
- Flexible dosing schedules (daily, EOD, 2x/week, 5-on-2-off, custom)
- Titration and cycle planning
- Progress tracking with Apple Health sync
- In-app encyclopedia of peptides with half-life data
- Privacy-first: records stay on the iPhone, no server storage; Export My Data saves a copy

## Pricing (US App Store, as of October 2026)
- Free download with a 14-day free trial
- Then $9.99/year (the App Store lists one in-app purchase, "Jabbit Pro", at $9.99)
- iPhone app (iOS 17 or later; the listing says it also runs on iPad); no Android app
